annotation.title_clean: Resolución 710/2024 - Ministerio de Seguridad: Creación de la Unidad de Inteligencia Artificial Aplicada a la Seguridad (UIAAS)
annotation.title_en: Resolution 710/2024 - Ministry of Security: Creation of the Unit of Artificial Intelligence Applied to Security (UIAAS)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerio de Seguridad de la Nación (Argentina), Boletín Oficial de la República Argentina
annotation.venue: Boletín Oficial de la República Argentina
annotation.summary_en: Argentine Ministry of Security resolution creating the Unit of AI Applied to Security (UIAAS) within the Cybercrime Directorate. It authorizes AI for crime prevention and investigation, including social media patrolling, facial recognition, predictive policing, drone patrols and bomb-disposal robots, without dedicated safeguards.
key_provisions_or_claims: Creates the UIAAS under the Directorate of Cybercrime and Cyber Affairs.
Unit led by the Director and staffed by federal police and security force representatives.
Functions include real-time facial recognition on camera feeds and predictive crime analysis.
Authorizes drone patrols and robots for dangerous tasks such as explosive disposal.
Must conform to Resolution 428/2024 cyber crime prevention guidelines; no budget impact.
